baseline_definition: The historical standalone evidence baseline measures progress toward four self-contained field units that do not depend on a phone, server, or repeater; it is retained for continuity and is not the current V1 Companion release total.

baseline_milestones.name: Architecture and safety contracts
baseline_milestones.description: Protocol, recovery, privacy, group-size, and degraded-operation rules are documented and extensively host tested.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Close remaining product-firmware architecture gates with target evidence.

baseline_milestones.name: Core OpenTrail firmware
baseline_milestones.description: Hardware-neutral communication, status, alert, persistence, update, and recovery components plus a portable-client composition exist; real board bindings remain.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Bind the selected client hardware and prove the complete target composition.

baseline_milestones.name: Firmware loading app
baseline_milestones.description: A packaged Windows inspection shell identifies the three bench runtimes, presents non-authoritative vendor-family hardware candidates with explicit maintenance steps, and verifies bounded bundle structure, image SHA-256, and RSA-PSS-3072/SHA-256 when a signer is pinned; production trust, authoritative board matching, writing, and recovery remain absent.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Run separately authorized maintenance probes for received-board evidence, obtain independent trust review, and approve signer custody plus pinned production trust before implementing any writer.

baseline_milestones.name: Heltec V4 bench firmware
baseline_milestones.description: Two assembled Heltec V4 units retain bounded historical MeshCore bench evidence. OT-DEV-001 is an experimental OpenTrail target with exact-profile build, physical boot/BLE advertisement, and startup/status OLED evidence. The exact installed partition table and blank protected-storage source region passed a bounded physical proof, the installed application is privately retained for recovery, and one exact recovery route plus protected-root provider/inventory contracts are accepted. OT-081 adds a build-compiled six-slot coarse key-roster leaf; OT-082 adds a separate build-compiled default NVS-configuration and decoded security-state leaf. OT-083 rejects the conditional custom USER_DATA rollback-floor candidate because its Reed-Solomon coding unit cannot support repeated writes. OT-084 also rejects SECURE_VERSION because its 16-step application-firmware anti-rollback role and OTA-only native model conflict with an independent authorization floor and the accepted factory recovery route. No viable on-chip floor provider is selected; external monotonic hardware would require a future hardware revision. The two target leaves are host-tested, have no runtime call path, were not device-executed, cannot prove complete inventory or provider suitability, and grant no physical allocation or authority.
baseline_milestones.evidence_status: Experimental physical target with startup/status OLED
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Make the owner product-direction decision: approve a future authenticated external monotonic-hardware revision, defer rollback-protected authorization beyond current V1, or explicitly revise the rollback threat requirement.

baseline_milestones.name: Firmware for the first complete unit
baseline_milestones.description: The display, internal radio/GNSS module, power path, enclosure, and exact production target still require a frozen build and integration.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Freeze the exact hardware and complete one recoverable end-to-end client.

baseline_milestones.name: Four-person V1 field proof
baseline_milestones.description: Four identical standalone clients must pass recovery, range, endurance, usability, and repeatable field trials before V1.
baseline_milestones.next_gate: Run the frozen four-unit standalone pilot and accept its evidence.

release_tracks.name: V1 Companion
release_tracks.definition: A complete V1 Companion release means four Trail Essential device-and-Android-phone pairs can be installed, privately authorized, used for direct group communication and location awareness, recovered, and field tested without depending on a server or internet connection.
release_tracks.rounding_rule: Calculate the exact weighted result, then round to the nearest whole percentage for public display.

milestones.next_gate: Accept production signing and board authority, then prove bounded writing, verification, and recovery.

milestones.name: Heltec V4 / Trail Essential target
milestones.description: One experimental target has exact-profile build, physical boot, startup/status OLED, heartbeat, privacy-safe BLE-advertisement evidence, a bounded physical partition/source proof, a privately retained exact application recovery artifact, and accepted recovery/protected-root contracts. OT-081 adds a build-compiled six-slot coarse key-roster leaf; OT-082 adds a separate build-compiled default NVS-configuration and decoded security-state leaf. OT-083 rejects the custom USER_DATA rollback-floor candidate, and OT-084 rejects SECURE_VERSION because its 16-step firmware anti-rollback role and OTA-only native model conflict with the independent authorization floor and accepted factory recovery route. No viable on-chip floor provider is selected; external monotonic hardware would require a future hardware revision. Both target leaves are host-tested, have no runtime call path, were not device-executed, and provide no complete-inventory output, physical allocation, or authority.
milestones.next_gate: Make the owner product-direction decision between a future authenticated external monotonic-hardware revision, deferring rollback-protected authorization beyond current V1, or explicitly revising the rollback threat requirement.

milestones.name: Android companion application
milestones.description: Two of five equal evidence gates are accepted: build/install/lifecycle/artwork acceptance and exact-service discovery; connection, protected authorization, and operational release acceptance remain open.
milestones.evidence_status: Build tested with bounded physical observations
milestones.next_gate: Prove physical GATT connection and negotiation, protected one-phone authorization and Ready, then operational and release acceptance.

milestones.name: Four-person Companion field proof
milestones.description: Four frozen Trail Essential and supported Android pairs must pass recovery, range, endurance, usability, and repeatable field trials before V1 Companion.
milestones.next_gate: Approve the Companion pilot amendment, freeze four device-phone pairs, and run the accepted field sequence.

change_log.reason: Established the first evidence-weighted V1 Companion baseline. Shared architecture, core firmware, loader, and Heltec evidence are counted once; Android receives two of five equal gates for physical install/lifecycle/artwork and exact-service discovery, while live GATT, protected authorization and Ready, operational release acceptance, and four-person field proof remain open.
Recorded one consumed, sanitized OT-DEV-001 source-read denial and owner-observed startup/status return. Source proof remains absent, so no milestone completion changed.

Accepted the exact installed partition-table and complete blank protected-storage source-region proof on OT-DEV-001, followed by the owner-observed startup/status return. This satisfies only the source prerequisite, so no milestone completion changed.
Accepted a private exact capture of the installed OT-064 application as recovery input. The recovery route and every transition authority remain open, so no milestone completion changed.

Accepted the exact source-restore route, expected disabled security-state preflight, post-first-write recovery-uncertain policy, and protected-key/rollback-floor requirements offline. Physical recovery, concrete providers, fresh unified evidence, and every transition authority remain open, so no milestone completion changed.

Selected the two protected-key provider roles and a conditional custom user-eFuse thermometer floor class offline. Exact physical allocations, inventory, provisioning, recovery, fresh unified evidence, and every transition authority remain open, so no milestone completion changed.

Accepted the offline protected-root inventory plan and pure supplied-evidence verifier. At OT-079 acceptance no complete inventory reader/orchestrator existed, no device inventory or allocation was observed, and every physical, provisioning, runtime, and transition authority remained closed, so no milestone completion changed.

Rejected unsafe host-side eFuse materialization and accepted only a pure target-side decoded-metadata interface contract. No adapter, device read, floor descriptor, allocation, provisioning, or runtime authority exists, so no milestone completion changed.

Accepted the build-only six-slot coarse key-roster adapter after strict host/static checks, the complete host gate, and two identical pinned target builds. It has no runtime call path, was not device-executed, and cannot prove complete inventory or provider suitability, so no milestone completion changed.

Accepted the build-only default NVS-configuration and decoded security-state source after strict host/static checks, the complete 145-executable host gate, and two identical pinned target builds. It has no runtime call path, was not device-executed, and cannot prove current device state, complete inventory, or provider suitability, so no milestone completion changed.

Rejected the conditional custom USER_DATA eFuse rollback-floor candidate after pinned ESP-IDF evidence proved its Reed-Solomon coding unit cannot support repeated independent writes. The two protected HMAC roles remain selected by type, but no viable floor provider is selected and no device or runtime changed, so no milestone completion changed.

Rejected ESP32-S3 SECURE_VERSION as the independent companion-authorization floor after pinned ESP-IDF evidence proved its 16-step firmware anti-rollback role and OTA-only native model conflict with the accepted factory recovery route. External monotonic hardware remains a future hardware-revision option with no part selected, and no device or runtime changed, so no milestone completion changed.

release_tracks.definition: A future V2 Integrated release moves the user interface onto a dedicated touchscreen client while retaining the shared Trail protocol and safety foundation.
release_tracks.measurement_gate: Approve V2-specific touchscreen, input, power, enclosure, recovery, and field milestones before publishing a percentage.
